text.p: Earnings Per Share of Common Stock 0.29 0.27
NOTE: Net income for Q2 1997 includes $5 million charge from minority investment in Nets Inc, which filed for bankruptcy during the quarter.
Average Number of Shares Outstanding(In Million) 170.0 170.0

(1) This adjustment relates to revenues from businesses included in continuing operations that have been divested. In accordance with APB No. 30, these cannot be treated as discontinued operations. This includes American Credit Indemnity and the Proprietary West operations of R.H. Donnelley.
(2) Operating Cost adjustments of $129.2 million consist of the following:
- A reduction of $20.1 million of operating expenses relating to companies described in (1) above.

- A reduction of $96.4 million of expense relating to the non-recurring charges associated with losses on the sale of ACI and the Proprietary West operations of R.H. Donnelley ($88.8) plus transaction costs ($7.6 million) associated with the spin-off of Cognizant Corp and ACNielsen Corp.
- A reduction of $12.7 million to adjust Corporate overhead to expected future levels.
(3) This adjustment represents increases in net interest expense to anticipated levels.

(4) This adjustment brings the provision for income taxes to the Corporation's expected effective tax rate of approximately 34%. This primarily eliminates the tax expense associated with the adjustments noted above.
(5) This adjustment represents the Net Income of the Discontinued Operations which includes Cognizant Corp, ACNielsen Corp, D&B Software and NCH Promotional Services.

(a) In the fourth quarter of 1996, the Company changed its revenue recognition accounting policy in connection with its Directory Information Services segment, effective January 1, 1996. This accounting change had no impact on full-year results. The change which is reflected in the "As Reported" results above, resulted in shifting second quarter revenue ($27.1 million), operating income ($27.5 million) and earnings per share ($0.11) from the second quarter into subsequent quarters.
